newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down weekend rate play.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down weekend rate play.

text.p: * Volume heavier at $183.80 million vs $106.50 million
The Philippine peso ended weaker on Friday at 26.345 to the dollar from its previous close of 26.343 due to the weekend arbitrage play, traders said.
Banks sold dollars for settlement today and bought up the foreign currency for settlement on Tuesday next week to take advantage of the interest differential, traders said.
"The market took a cue from Central Bank which sold dollars in the morning between $25 and $32 million at 26.35," a trader said.
Late in the session, the Central Bank bought $10 to $15 million at 26.346.
The local currency hit a low 26.351 as some banks bought dollars for settlement on Wednesday next week.
Volume was higher on Friday at $183.80 million compared with $106.50 million the previous day.
